title: Mute on Minimize
description: Lightweight mod that automatically mutes Minecraft when minimized/out of focus.
body:
### Overview
**Mute on Minimize (MoM)** is a small, standalone, lightweight client-side mod that mutes Minecraft whenever it is minimized or out of focus. Useful for alt-tabbers.

Utilizes Mixin to inject into Minecraft's Window, only triggering when the game gains or loses focus. It doesn't run anything every tick.
